acceptanceCriteria: V1-1265 lands `citation` through `make cem-stable-regen` with the case 21/22 and 10-cell overrides recorded in CHANGES.md.
All listed closed-key constants are bumped in the same change and the native and interop suites pass.
The native/portable citation disagreement on the nine listed cases is resolved by a spec'd rule, with both consumers agreeing on every S0E case.
body: Findings from the V1-1273 proof run (2026-10-12, throwaway worktree on PR #821 head merged with origin/main, both P0 patches, `citation` regenerated after artifactChecks). Use them when V1-1265 lands the member. (1) Values: 54 cases come from the native capture (CEM_STABLE_REGEN_CAPTURE on go1.27.2); cases 21 and 22 (go1.24.13-only) need --values: case 21 = the native ComputeCitation block (produced on go1.27.2 with the binding check bypassed), case 22 = null. Envelope cells: 19 of 29 derive from captured cases; 10 need --cell-values (4 sha256 ACCEPT cells = the native ordinary-sha256 value; 6 early repository refusals = null). (2) Consumers pinning the closed 21-key shape that must become 22 in the same change: cmd/corvint/cem_stable_test.go:17; internal/cem/cli/stable_test.go:28; internal/cem/cli/stable_read_test.go:221; internal/cem/cli/stable_report_test.go:44; internal/cemcandidate/stable_test.go:113; interop/cem01-go/stable_repository_test.go:123; internal/cem/verify/stable_repository_test.go:333-334 (the requireS0EResult constant). interop/cem01-go/citation_test.go:470 (TestCEMV1082StableResultKeepsSealedShape) asserts 21 keys and a null citation and must be rewritten. (3) Consumer disagreement: interop TestStableCanonicalFullResults differs on key `citation` for cases 08, 09, 10, 11, 13, 50, 51, 53, 54: native carries a citation block on late cancellations/refusals, portable emits null. Per CEM-V1-091 this is a consumer defect to resolve (decide which side is the contract, probably null on any non-ACCEPT outcome) before regeneration, never by editing captured values. (4) V1-1265 must also add the `provenance` member and the closed producer-only-members list (chore bind/seal class for V1-1281); each is one more cem-stable-regen run, so plan the key count accordingly. Scratch patches with the six constant bumps and the adapted P0 patch exist only in the session scratchpad and are not authoritative.

completion.reason: Landed in PR beamfall/corvint#828 (merge 1f35e3da7e8b0dee971d280a7feb52c52ae2ef78): citation regenerated with cem-stable-regen, closed-key constants bumped to 23 in all seven consumers, nine S0E citation disagreements resolved by CEM-V1-092 citation only on ACCEPT, provenance member landed; interop and verify parity tests green. Evidence note digest attached.
